subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw publish `PluginHookAgentContext.api.resetSession(reason?)` as a supported after-compaction plugin API, or keep session resets behind an owner-specific/internal seam until a broader plugin lifecycle contract is designed?
rationale: This is a new public plugin capability with session-state effects; correctness fixes can narrow implementation details, but maintainers must choose the durable SDK boundary and support commitment.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow hook API
options.body: Approve a documented after-compaction-only `resetSession(reason?)` contract, then require the branch to preserve existing loop-detection behavior and prove the exact lifecycle end to end.

options.title: Keep reset internal for now
options.body: Remove the public hook API and retain only owner-controlled reset behavior until plugin lifecycle/session ownership is specified separately.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Approve a documented after-compaction-only `resetSession(reason?)` contract, then require the branch to preserve existing loop-detection behavior and prove the exact lifecycle end to end.
